name: Kinetica-2 (Lijian-2, CAS Space)

cd.note: aero only: LM-3B family fitted Cd transferred (3.35 m core + 2 side modules), see fixed_params; ASSUMPTION

glow_kg.note: 625 t (also https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kinetica-2); used as a CHECK only (sim GLOW reported in mass_budget)

propellant_kg.derived: = burned: 9-engine mdot 2733.6 kg/s (7380 kN / (275.3 s x g0)) x 180 s burn; no load published

dry_kg.derived: prop x (1/0.92 - 1): CAS Space Y1 report 'structure coefficient not below 0.92' for the tanks (huijiwiki quoting CAS Space Y1 release); applied to whole stage = ASSUMPTION

thrust_sl_N.note: liftoff thrust 7380 kN from 9x YF-102 (= 820 kN rated each, 2024-10-15 test, same page)

thrust_vac_N.derived: SL 7380 kN x Merlin 1D vac/SL thrust ratio 914/845 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SpaceX_Merlin): ASSUMPTION (YF-102 vac thrust unpublished; analogous open-cycle kerolox engine)

isp_vac_s.derived: SL Isp 275.3 s (https://zh.wikipedia.org/wiki/YF-102; huijiwiki YF-102 'not below 275 s') x same ratio, so mdot = F/(Isp g0) is unchanged from the published SL pair

cutoff_s.derived: upper bound: 720 s cumulative engine test time 'meets not less than 4x flight operating time' (huijiwiki 2024-08-13 entry) -> flight burn <= 180 s; burn to the bound ASSUMED. Booster and core cutoff/separation together = ASSUMPTION (booster sep unpublished; CBC 'bundled recovery' concept)

separation_s.assumption: 1 s after cutoff; S1/S2 separation time left BLANK in the published typical sequence (https://sat.huijiwiki.com/wiki/力箭二号)

propellant_kg.derived: = burned: mdot 219.4 kg/s (710 kN / (330 s x g0)) x (493.71 - 183.0) s; no load published

dry_kg.derived: prop x (1/0.92 - 1), same structure-coefficient ASSUMPTION as S1

thrust_vac_N.note: YF-102V 710 kN vac (huijiwiki, citing CALT/AALPT engine sheet); unofficial table, 55-100% throttle unmodelled (full thrust ASSUMED)

cutoff_s.note: '二级发动机一次关机 493.710 s', typical flight sequence (CAS Space Y1 documentary, ref 52)

mass_kg.assumption: not published; carbon-composite 4.2 m x 12.19 m fairing (https://sat.huijiwiki.com/wiki/力箭二号), mass ASSUMED

vertical_rise_s.assumption: not published for Kinetica-2; 15 s = LM-2C published programme-turn time (https://sat.huijiwiki.com/wiki/长征二号丙), borrowed

cd.derived: FITTED LM-3B value transferred (aero only); filled at run time from vehicles/lm3b.json fitted_family; ASSUMPTION

payload_kg.basis: upper bound LEO capability 12 t (huijiwiki/W); 18 Qianfan sats (unofficial count) mass not published

header_notes: Kinetica-2 TIMELINE mode: thrust/Isp/GLOW/fairing/typical event times from huijiwiki (CAS Space sources) + zh.wikipedia YF-102; ALL propellant/dry masses DERIVED from burn x mdot and the published 0.92 structure coefficient. S1 burn 180 s is the derived upper bound (ASSUMED). UNTUNED: no altitude/range knots published; LOW confidence.
